name: mobile-bottom-action-bar
title: Mobile Bottom Action Bar
description: Safe-area-aware fixed mobile actions with automatic dynamic-height content reservation.
docs: Render at the end of the page content in the main scrolling flow. The pattern reserves its measured mobile height; remove previous manual bottom padding. Keep a single bar per page and do not place it in a transformed or separately scrolling ancestor. It becomes inline from 768px. Pass QH Button elements as actions; a single action fills the row.
